g.text: U4 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8: 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, which takes GPIO35 to 37.

g.desc: U4 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8: 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, which takes GPIO35 to 37.

g.text: Rated to 65 C, or 85 C with PSRAM ECC on: firmware must enable it. C14 and C15 at pin 2.

g.desc: Rated to 65 C, or 85 C with PSRAM ECC on: firmware must enable it. C14 and C15 at pin 2.

g.text: No valve, relay or enable function is on a GPIO. The valve outputs are on the I2C expander,

g.desc: No valve, relay or enable function is on a GPIO. The valve outputs are on the I2C expander,

g.text: which the fail-safe circuit holds in reset. Only KA (GPIO17) and I2C0 can influence a valve.

g.desc: which the fail-safe circuit holds in reset. Only KA (GPIO17) and I2C0 can influence a valve.

g.text: KA is on module pin 10, between ENC_B and BTN_BACK, on purpose: no net beside it toggles by

g.desc: KA is on module pin 10, between ENC_B and BTN_BACK, on purpose: no net beside it toggles by

g.text: itself. Do not move it without redoing section 8.5 of the hardware design for its neighbours.

g.desc: itself. Do not move it without redoing section 8.5 of the hardware design for its neighbours.

g.text: GPIO0 BOOT: R19 pull-up and button SW2. Low at reset selects download mode.

g.desc: GPIO0 BOOT: R19 pull-up and button SW2. Low at reset selects download mode.

g.text: GPIO3 VIN_MON: analogue input, held low at reset by its 10k divider leg.

g.desc: GPIO3 VIN_MON: analogue input, held low at reset by its 10k divider leg.

g.text: GPIO45 SENS_PWR_EN: 100k to GND and one CMOS input. Never add a pull-up to this net.

g.desc: GPIO45 SENS_PWR_EN: 100k to GND and one CMOS input. Never add a pull-up to this net.

g.text: GPIO46 STATUS_LED: R20 and D6 to GND can only pull down.

g.desc: GPIO46 STATUS_LED: R20 and D6 to GND can only pull down.

g.text: ADC1 only: GPIO1 ADC_LO, GPIO2 ADC_HI, GPIO3 VIN_MON, GPIO7 RLY_B_RB.

g.desc: ADC1 only: GPIO1 ADC_LO, GPIO2 ADC_HI, GPIO3 VIN_MON, GPIO7 RLY_B_RB.

g.text: GPIO7 and GPIO42 read back the two keep-alive detectors. They stay inputs for the life of the

g.desc: GPIO7 and GPIO42 read back the two keep-alive detectors. They stay inputs for the life of the

g.text: firmware. GPIO40 reads the over-current latch through 10k.

g.desc: firmware. GPIO40 reads the over-current latch through 10k.

g.text: USB: GPIO19 D-, GPIO20 D+, through the series footprints on the USB sheet.

g.desc: USB: GPIO19 D-, GPIO20 D+, through the series footprints on the USB sheet.

g.desc: U12 TLV803EA29: open drain, pulls EN low while 3V3 is under 2.93 V (2.87 to 2.99 V) and for

g.desc: 130 to 270 ms after. R18 10k and C16 1 uF delay EN by about 10 ms. SW1 is reset.
